name: Barrage
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You create a hovering cloud of stones that you can propel across the battlefield. Roll Spirit. The result becomes the Difficulty. The result, halved, is the number of stones under your control. Check a Condition.

While you control at least one stone, you may choose to do any of the following:

  • Spend a half action to send a small stone toward a creature within medium range. It must roll Dexterity against the Difficulty. On a failure, it takes 1d6 damage.

  • Spend an action to send a large stone toward a creature within medium range. It must roll Dexterity against the Difficulty. On a failure, it takes 2d10 damage.

  • Spend a half action to gain control over 1d4 additional stones.

  • Spend a reaction to interrupt a creature's movement. It must roll Dexterity against the Difficulty. On a failure, it falls prone.

The spell draws from loose stones within short range, or tears chunks from nearby stone surfaces or objects. If no stone is available within short range when you cast the spell, it fails.

Describe the barrage.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: You may add HEART to each damage roll.
